stage_name_zh: Stage 2: 深度病段诊所与论证加固（去AI味、五病根治、Toulmin论证与让步反驳）
daily_focus_title_zh: 第 18 天：主实验结果整体对比与核心胜出原因剖析段（Main Results Analysis） × 口头学术演讲的听觉信息流：短分句、视觉锚点与设问引导（Oral Signposting） × Failure_Mode_Report 全篇梳理

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: AI/CS 小论文：Experiments 主结果、消融归因与 Limitations 讨论（BP17–BP24）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 主实验结果整体对比与核心胜出原因剖析段（Main Results Analysis）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想解读主实验大表（Table 1）：既报告全局胜率，又挑出最有代表性的对比案例，解释为什么竞争对手在那里跌倒而我们稳赢。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: Experiments 第 4.2 节 Main Results
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [全局统治力概述 Overall Dominance]：Table 1 summarizes the multivariate forecasting results, where [Our Model] achieves the lowest error in [X] out of [Y] dataset-horizon configurations.

S2 [对比流派 1 的差距与原因 Contrast vs. Family 1]：Compared with channel-independent baselines such as [Baseline A], our method reduces average MSE by [X%] on [Dataset], where strong cross-sensor coupling is critical.

S3 [对比流派 2 在困难场景下的崩溃 Contrast vs. Family 2 under Hard Regime]：Furthermore, while [Baseline B] performs competitively at short horizons ($H=96$), its error escalates by [Y%] at $H=720$ due to [Failure Mechanism].
S4 [回扣本文核心机制 Mechanistic Confirmation]：By contrast, our [Core Module] bounds long-range drift, maintaining a [Z%] margin over the second-best baseline at $H=720$.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Global Win Rate -> Advantage over Family A -> Resilience at Long Horizon vs. Family B -> Mechanistic Takeaway. 绑定逻辑规则：L015, L013, L010.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: As shown in Table 1, our model gets the best MSE on ETTm1, ETTm2, Weather, and Traffic. On Weather dataset, our MSE is 0.165, which is 12% lower than PatchTST. On Traffic, our MSE is 0.382, which beats iTransformer. This proves our model is the best.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 典型的“报账式朗读表格”，只报数字不分析机理，末句 This proves our model is the best 毫无信息量。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Table 1 reports the multivariate forecasting results, where DyTS-Net secures the lowest error in 25 out of 28 dataset-horizon configurations. Compared with channel-independent PatchTST, DyTS-Net reduces average MSE by 14.2% on the 862-channel Traffic benchmark, where modeling spatial-temporal congestion propagation across adjacent road sensors is critical. Furthermore, while variate-mixing iTransformer performs competitively at $H=96$, its MSE escalates by 68% at $H=720$ on volatile Weather series as unregularized cross-channel attention overfits transient wind gusts. By decoupling stationary phase coupling from neural-ODE scale projection, DyTS-Net suppresses long-horizon drift and maintains an 11.6% margin over the strongest baseline at $H=720$.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 小作文与图表/数据综合写作：IELTS Task 1 / TOEFL Integrated / 科研趋势报告（BP25–BP32）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 历史实测与未来预测跨时态衔接段（Historical vs. Projected Trends）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想处理同时包含过去历史数据（如 2010–2025）和未来预测数据（如 2026–2040）的图表段落，严格区分过去实测时态与未来审慎预测表达。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: IELTS Task 1 含未来预测年份的图表 / 产业算力与能耗预测报告
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [历史实测轨迹 Historical Trajectory (Past Tense)]：Between [2010] and [2025], global data-center electricity demand rose steadily from [200 TWh] to [460 TWh], driven by cloud migration.
S2 [当下转折与未来加速 Projected Acceleration (Projection Verbs)]：From [2026] onward, consumption is projected to accelerate sharply, with forecasts indicating a surge to [1,050 TWh] by [2035].

S3 [结构占比重塑 Structural Shift in Projections]：Within this projected expansion, generative AI training and inference—which accounted for less than [10%] in [2023]—are anticipated to represent over [45%] of total load by [2040].
S4 [条件式审慎收尾 Conditional Hedging]：Nevertheless, energy-efficient hardware adoption is expected to moderate the growth slope during the final five years.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Historical Past (rose/accounted for) -> Pivot Year -> Future Projection Verbs (is projected/anticipated/expected to) -> Moderating Factor. 绑定逻辑规则：L010, L017.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: From 2010 to 2025, demand increased from 200 to 460. In 2035, it will increase to 1050. AI was 10% in 2023 and will be 45% in 2040.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 未来年份全部生硬使用 will be / will increase，违反学术图表报告对未来预测需使用审慎预测动词（is projected / anticipated / forecast to）的规范。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Between 2010 and 2025, global data-center electricity consumption more than doubled from 200 TWh to 460 TWh. From 2026 onward, total demand is projected to climb at a substantially steeper rate, with baseline forecasts pointing to 1,050 TWh by 2035. Within this expansion, AI model training and inference—which represented under 10% of server load in 2023—are anticipated to account for nearly half (46%) of total consumption by 2040. However, widespread deployment of sparsity-aware accelerators is expected to temper the annual growth rate after 2035.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 学术演讲（Tech Talk）/ 顶会审稿回复（Rebuttal）/ 科研个人陈述（SoP）（BP41–BP48）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 演讲中化繁为简讲解核心公式与算法直觉（Explaining Math Orally）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想在 PPT 上出现核心损失函数或注意力公式时，用 4 句通俗、精准的口语把公式背后的物理/几何直觉讲透，而不是在台上干巴巴念希腊字母。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: 学术演讲方法详解页（Explaining Equations on Slides）
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [先讲直觉目标 Intuition First]：Before looking at the math at the bottom of the slide, here is the simple physical intuition we want to capture.
S2 [日常/物理类比 Physical Analogy]：When two sensors monitor the same mechanical shaft, genuine vibrations share a consistent phase lag, whereas random electrical glitches fire out of phase.
S3 [指向公式核心项 Point to Key Term]：That is exactly what the red penalty term $\|\Delta \Phi\|_1$ inside the softmax does: it measures phase mismatch between channels.
S4 [一句话总结效果 Operational Effect]：Whenever two channels fall out of phase, this term suppresses their attention weight automatically.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Intuition Before Symbols -> Physical Reality -> Pointer to Highlighted Math Term -> Operational Effect. 绑定逻辑规则：L014, L018.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: The formula on this slide is Q times K transpose divided by square root of d minus lambda times delta phi L1 norm, and then softmax times V.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 在台上把公式符号逐字念一遍（Q times K transpose divided by...）是学术演讲的大忌，听众听得云里雾里。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Before looking at the equation in the middle box, here is the physical intuition behind it. When two sensors sit on the same turbine shaft, genuine mechanical vibrations travel with a consistent phase lag, whereas random sensor glitches fire completely out of phase. That physical rule is captured by the highlighted red term, $\|\Delta \Phi_{Q,K}\|_1$, right inside the softmax. Whenever two channels show inconsistent phase lag, this penalty automatically zeroes out their attention weight.

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 口头学术演讲的听觉信息流：短分句、视觉锚点与设问引导（Oral Signposting）
focal_logic_rules.name_en: Spoken Rhythm, Visual Anchoring, and Rhetorical Signposting
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 听众无法像读论文那样倒回去重读长定语从句。把书面段转化为演讲稿时，必须：① 砍掉多重嵌套从句，拆为 10–15 词的清晰短句；② 先给视觉坐标（Look at the red curve in the upper-right panel）再讲结论；③ 用轻量设问（Why does this spike happen? Because...）引导注意力。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: [Visual Anchor: Turning to the right panel of Slide 4,] -> [Short Rhetorical Question: why does the baseline diverge after step 50?] -> [Crisp Causal Answer: The answer lies in compound orientation drift.]
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 拿着书面论文原封不动照念长达 40 个词的复合句，台下听众在前 10 秒就丢失了主谓关系。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: As illustrated in Figure 4, the trajectory generated by the baseline model without temporal consistency regularization exhibits substantial oscillation around the target waypoint.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Take a look at the dashed blue trajectory in Figure 4. Notice how violently the robot arm oscillates near the target waypoint. Why does this happen? Without temporal consistency regularization, adjacent action chunks conflict with one another.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 用 Take a look at... -> Notice how... -> Why does this happen? -> Without X, Y conflicts... 营造极具现场掌控力的母语级 Tech Talk 节奏。

focal_logic_rules.category: Domain Discourse (生成模型专属论证)
focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 生成模型三元权衡论证规范：生成质量、模式覆盖度与采样效率（Generative Trilemma Logic）
focal_logic_rules.name_en: Fidelity, Mode Coverage, and Sampling Efficiency Trilemma
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 分析生成模型（Diffusion, Flow Matching, Autoregressive, GAN, VAE）时，段落逻辑应围绕生成三难困境（Trilemma）展开：① 样本保真度（Sample Fidelity / Temporal Realism）、② 分布模式覆盖度/多样性（Mode Coverage / Diversity，防止 Mode Collapse）、③ 推理采样步数与速度（Inference NFE / Sampling Latency）。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: While [Model Family A] excels at [Fidelity/Diversity], it incurs [High NFE / Mode Collapse]. -> By reformulating the generation trajectory via [Rectified Flow / Consistency Distillation], our approach preserves [Property 1] while reducing sampling steps from [N] to [k].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 只说 the generated samples look very good and realistic，缺乏分布覆盖度与采样效率维度的严谨坐标。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Diffusion models generate very realistic data, but they are too slow. Our model makes them fast and still good.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: While denoising diffusion models capture multi-modal trajectory distributions without mode collapse, their reliance on tens of iterative solver steps precludes real-time control. By straightening the probability flow ODE via reflow distillation, our generator preserves multi-modal path diversity while compressing inference to a single forward pass.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 精准使用 multi-modal trajectory distributions、without mode collapse、iterative solver steps、straightening the probability flow ODE 等领域高阶表达。

focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 具身智能视觉运动策略与仿真到真实迁移
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想解读主实验大表（Table 1）：既报告全局胜率，又挑出最有代表性的对比案例，解释为什么竞争对手在那里跌倒而我们稳赢。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: As shown in Table 1, our model gets the best MSE on ETTm1, ETTm2, Weather, and Traffic. On Weather dataset, our MSE is 0.165, which is 12% lower than PatchTST. On Traffic, our MSE is 0.382, which beats iTransformer. This proves our model is the best.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L018 口头学术演讲的听觉信息流：短分句、视觉锚点与设问引导（Oral Signposting））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 典型的“报账式朗读表格”，只报数字不分析机理，末句 This proves our model is the best 毫无信息量。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。

focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想回应 'Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?' 题型：把弊端定性为“暂时的、可通过技术/规则收敛的局部成本”，把优势定性为“不可替代的结构性长期突破”。

focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Weighing both dimensions demonstrates that the structural scientific gains of open-weight foundation models far outweigh their manageable misuse risks. While公开 releasing model weights lowers the barrier for generating deceptive phishing content, such downstream abuse can be substantially contained through cryptographic provenance standards and endpoint spam filters. By contrast, open weights provide academic laboratories and resource-constrained hospitals with transparent, auditable architectures that proprietary black-box APIs cannot substitute—accelerating reproducible breakthroughs in protein folding and rare-disease diagnostics. Because the security risks are mitigable via defense-in-depth whereas the scientific transparency is irreplaceable, open research ecosystems yield a decisive net benefit.

focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Recovering missing sensor observations is essential for reliable downstream monitoring in industrial and clinical time series. While diffusion-based imputation models generate plausible trajectories under random missingness, they suffer from high sampling latency and lose global periodic coherence when entire sensor blocks drop out consecutively. We present FlowImp, a conditional flow-matching framework that reconstructs contiguous missing blocks in three ODE solver steps. Specifically, FlowImp anchors straight transport paths on observed spectral priors and enforces cross-channel phase consistency via a lightweight Fourier regularizer. Across six multivariate benchmarks under 50% block missingness, FlowImp reduces imputation MAE by 19.3% compared with CSDI while accelerating inference by 24x.
